description: This Java class implements the CachesConfig interface for the Ditto Concierge service, providing configuration for cache timeouts and cache configurations for IDs and enforcers.

classes.name: DefaultCachesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing CachesConfig, managing cache timeout and cache configurations for the service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultCachesConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for the ask timeout.

methods.name: getIdCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for IDs.

methods.name: getEnforcerCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for enforcers.
